sentences.en: TUTOR: Right, Jason and Karin, now asked you to look at the case study for Box Telecom as part of your exam assessment
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 好的，杰森和卡琳，现在我让你们研究Box Telecom的案例分析，作为你们考试评估的一部分。

sentences.en: It's interesting because they are in the middle of problems at the moment and I want you to track how they deal with them
sentences.zh: 这很有趣，因为他们目前正面临诸多问题，而我希望你们追踪他们是如何应对这些问题的。

sentences.en: Let's start with you, Karin
sentences.zh: 我们先从你开始，卡琳。

sentences.en: Having read through the case study, can you just summarise what the problems were that Box Telecom had to take on board?
sentences.zh: 在通读完该案例分析后，你能简要概括一下Box Telecom所必须面对的问题吗？

sentences.en: KARIN: Um, yeah
sentences.zh: KARIN: 嗯，好的……

sentences.en: Well of course what first came to their attention was that, despite a new advertising campaign, they were suffering from falling sales and this is something that had many causes
sentences.zh: 当然，首先引起他们注意的是：尽管开展了新的广告宣传活动，他们的销售额却持续下滑，而这一现象由多种原因造成。

sentences.en: On top of that immediate problem, what had also happened over the last two years was that, although they had invested in an expansion plan, they had to face up to increased competition
sentences.zh: 除了这一迫在眉睫的问题之外，过去两年中还发生了另一件事：尽管他们已投资于一项扩张计划，却不得不直面日益加剧的竞争。

sentences.en: And, before they had a chance to get to grips with the effects of that, they were stalled by a strike and it was just when they were thinking about making a colossal investment in new machinery for their plants
sentences.zh: 而且，在他们尚未来得及充分应对上述影响之际，一场罢工又使他们陷入停滞——而这场罢工恰恰发生在他们正考虑为工厂购置新设备投入巨额资金之时。

sentences.en: So they were really in trouble
sentences.zh: 因此，他们确实陷入了困境。

sentences.en: TUTOR: Yes, I think that's fair
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 是的，我认为这种说法是公允的。

sentences.en: And Jason, you contacted the company, didn't you?
sentences.zh: 杰森，你联系过这家公司，对吗？

sentences.en: What did the company define as the reasons for these problems?
sentences.zh: 该公司将这些问题的原因归结为何？

sentences.en: At the same time, their longer-term problems, which were affecting their market share, were eventually credited to poor training - and having looked at the details in their last report think that's right
sentences.zh: 与此同时，影响其市场份额的长期问题最终被归因于员工培训不足；在查阅了他们最近一份报告的详细内容后，我认为这一判断是正确的。

sentences.en: TUTOR: So, onto the larger issues then
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 那么，接下来我们讨论更宏观的问题。

sentences.en: Karin, what do you think the company will do?
sentences.zh: 卡琳，你认为这家公司会采取什么举措？

sentences.en: KARIN: Hmm
sentences.zh: KARIN: 嗯……

sentences.en: Well, obviously they have the choice of accepting the very favourable terms that another company - KMG Plc have given them to buy them out
sentences.zh: 显然，他们可以选择接受另一家公司——KMG Plc提出的极为优厚的收购条件。

sentences.en: That would mean creating a new company with a new image
sentences.zh: 这意味着将组建一家拥有全新形象的新公司。

sentences.en: Or a they could decide on a bolder move and offer some new shares if they wanted
sentences.zh: 或者，他们也可选择更大胆的举措，比如增发新股。

sentences.en: But think they're much more cautious than that and expect they will start trying to find individuals who'd be prepared to back them with some of the capital they need
sentences.zh: 但我认为他们远比这谨慎得多，预计他们会开始寻找愿意以部分所需资本支持他们的个人投资者。

sentences.en: TUTOR: Well, you mustn't always assume that dramatic problems require dramatic solutions
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 嗯，你们切不可总以为棘手的问题必然需要激进的解决方案。

sentences.en: Sometimes there's a simple fix such as changing the guy at the top
sentences.zh: 有时一个简单的办法就足以解决，比如更换高层管理者。

sentences.en: If they truly are cautious, then I suspect they will seek to shut down some of their shops
sentences.zh: 如果他们的确十分谨慎，那么我推测他们可能会关闭部分门店。

sentences.en: But a more ambitious approach, and one which I think would have more chance of success, would be to alter how they're running things - the management layers and the processes
sentences.zh: 但更具雄心且在我看来更有可能成功的做法，则是调整其运营方式——即管理层级结构与业务流程。

sentences.en: So in your analysis try to think of all the options
sentences.zh: 因此，在你们的分析中，请务必全面考虑所有可能选项。

sentences.en: Jason?
sentences.zh: 杰森？

sentences.en: JASON: Yes, it's interesting because I've found it a really useful company to study
sentences.zh: JASON: 是的，这很有意思，因为我发现这家公司非常值得深入研究。

sentences.en: Its problems cross all types of industries and it's lucky it's so big - a smaller or even medium-sized company would have gone under by now
sentences.zh: 它所面临的问题横跨各类行业；而且它运气很好——规模足够庞大；若是一家小型甚至中等规模的公司，恐怕早已倒闭了。

sentences.en: TUTOR: Ah well in fact, what I want you two to do is to go away when we've finished our discussion today and write a report
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 啊，实际上，我希望你们两人在今天讨论结束后，各自回去撰写一份报告。

sentences.en: We've looked in general at the telecommunications market in the UK over the last few sessions and I want you to take Box Telecom as an example and suggest some ways in which they might overcome their problems
sentences.zh: 我们在之前几次课上已总体探讨了英国电信市场近况，现在我希望你们以Box Telecom为例，提出一些他们可能用以克服当前困境的方法。

sentences.en: And outline the reasons why you think as you do - but try and keep it intrinsic to the company rather than dragging in other examples
sentences.zh: 并阐明你们持此观点的理由——但请尽量紧扣该公司自身情况，避免牵扯其他案例。

sentences.en: Is that OK, Karin?
sentences.zh: 这样可以吗，卡琳？

sentences.en: KARIN: Yes, think can do that
sentences.zh: KARIN: 可以，我想我能完成。

sentences.en: Personally I've got great hopes for it
sentences.zh: 我个人对此抱有极大希望。

sentences.en: Lthink it will recover
sentences.zh: 我认为它必将复苏。

sentences.en: That advertising campaign they did was very strong and they're very innovative with their products - they set new trends
sentences.zh: 他们开展的那场广告宣传活动非常有力，而且其产品极具创新性——常常引领行业新潮流。

sentences.en: The company's got to recover, don't you think, Jason?
sentences.zh: 这家公司一定会复苏，对吧，杰森？

sentences.en: JASON: Hmmm - I'm not sure
sentences.zh: JASON: 嗯……我不太确定。

sentences.en: I think it can but it's not a foregone conclusion unless they manage to attract the right level of investment
sentences.zh: I think it can, but it's not a foregone conclusion unless they manage to attract the right level of investment

sentences.en: The company definitely 029 needs a boost and to attract more highly skilled workers if their recovery is to be long-lasting
sentences.zh: The company definitely needs a boost and to attract more highly skilled workers if their recovery is to be long-lasting

sentences.en: When was talking to the marketing manager he said to me that he thinks the company had got a great management team - but he would say that, wouldn't he? - but they are suffering from having to work with outdated production machinery and that could cost a lot to put right
sentences.zh: When I was talking to the marketing manager, he said to me that he thinks the company has got a great management team—but he would say that, wouldn't he?—but they are suffering from having to work with outdated production machinery, and that could cost a lot to put right

sentences.en: TUTOR: Well, personally I think the stock market is to blame
sentences.zh: TUTOR: Well, personally I think the stock market is to blame

sentences.en: I think they were expecting too much of the company and then inevitably it looked bad when it didn't perform
sentences.zh: I think they were expecting too much of the company, and then inevitably it looked bad when it didn't perform

sentences.en: The market should have had more realistic expectations
sentences.zh: The market should have had more realistic expectations

sentences.en: } SL19 And I disagree with you about the advertising campaign Karin
sentences.zh: } SL19 And I disagree with you about the advertising campaign, Karin

sentences.en: That's where they could do with some innovation - to get sales kick-started
sentences.zh: That's where they could do with some innovation—to get sales kick-started
